notes.summary: The page continues a discussion of supports: a presumed Boolean algebra and Stone-space interpretation, a long marginal reservation about distributivity, a compatibility-based cosupport definition, and an example of saturated parts. All three required source views and 20 independent local crops were actually viewed. Structural verification found balanced TeX grouping braces, matched TikZ environments, and exact agreement between the 16 remaining-doubt entries and reading.tex.
notes.math_reading_decisions: No proof or mathematical validation was attempted. Tracking the repeated P,Q,R factors prompted symbol-by-symbol inspection of the marginal equality, but the extra bracket-like marks were retained as ink doubts. The final prime doubt comes from the crowded high stroke, not a proposed change to the expected formula. C4 is only transcribed.
